query.title: Taskless direct-work readiness gap reproduced and fixed
query.body:
The sealed case-3 handover ends in a taskless project: repository f244159 (review commit), canonical head 95b83e7, current DELIVER conclusion. Replaying `palimpsest_work action=readiness` on the sealed owner databases reproduced a gap: the ordinary Work entry still said "no task is currently addressable; plan or begin work" instead of pointing at the recorded conclusion. The same gap occurred before any conclusion when a clean direct commit was ahead of the canonical basis.

Root cause: the readiness helper only handled committed artifacts of a retired plan. It had no taskless direct-delivery path. Fix in `src/application/work_outcome.ts`: a clean taskless project with a direct commit ahead of the canonical basis is now offered `conclude intent=DELIVER`; when the episode already has a current DELIVER conclusion, readiness points to that conclusion instead of asking for another one. Unchanged and uncommitted states still receive no delivery advice, and retired-plan, task, promotion and acceptance semantics are unchanged.

Verification: `node scripts/pnwf/software/self-maintenance-readiness.mjs` returns all six checks true. The focused suites (`test/alhs_episode_convergence.test.ts`, `test/pnwf_cq_basis_admission.test.ts`, `test/pnwf_cq_direct_governed.test.ts`) pass 22/22. Related work/continuity suites pass 43/43. The fixed readiness was replayed against the sealed case-3 owner state and returned SEMANTIC_JUDGEMENT with "reply using the recorded conclusion".

Candidate commit: 91b5bc0ca6690d673118af3d753056b26a7ab460. Raw evidence remains at evidence/case-3/session.jsonl, evidence/case-3/owners/, and evidence/prior-run/working.patch.
